{White's threat to f7 is ineffective in this position. How should Black defend
and achieve a good game?} 5... O-O {[%wrong White wins material. Try again and
look for the best way to defend your f7-pawn.] [%hint Safeguard your king and
defend f7 with a rook.]} (5... d5 $2 6. exd5 {White can meet Nxd5 with Nc3 and
start a strong attack. Try again and look for a better way to defend f7.}) (
5... Rf8 $2 6. c3 {Black can't castle and White keeps the initiative. Try
again and look for a better way to defend f7.}) (5... Qe7 $2 6. Bxf7+ {White
wins a pawn and prevents Black from castling. Try again and look for a better
way to defend f7.}) 6. Nxf7 {Good start! White captured on f7 anyway. How
should you respond?} Rxf7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look
for a good capture.] [%hint Recapture and avoid any discovered checks.]} 7.
Bxf7+ {Keep it up! What's next?} Kxf7 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try
again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture the bishop.] Good work!
Black's king is slightly exposed, but White has no developed pieces and Black
has an excellent position.} *

{White has chosen a bad moment to castle and Black can start a strong attack.
How should you do it?} 7... Nd4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find
a way to add more attackers against a pinned piece.] [%hint Add another
attacker against the pinned knight on f3.]} (7... Bxf3 $2 8. Qxf3 {White
recaptures with a good position. Try again and look for a way to build
pressure on the pinned knight before capturing it.}) (7... h6 $2 8. Bxf6 {
White will meet Qxf6 with Nd5 and take a slight initiative. Try again and look
for a way to target a pinned piece.}) (7... O-O $2 8. Nd5 {White will be the
first player to start exposing the opponent's king. Try again and look for a way
to target a pinned piece.}) 8. Nd5 {Good decision! White attempted to copy
Black's idea, but Black hasn't castled yet, so doubled pawns aren't an issue.
What should Black play?} c6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look
for a useful threat.] [%hint Chase White's knight from the center.]} (8...
Nxf3+ $5 {This is a good capture, but there's a threat that's even stronger.
Try to find it.}) (8... Bxf3 $2 9. gxf3 {Black is slightly better, but there's
a threat that's significantly stronger. Try to find it.}) (8... h6 $5 {This is
reasonable, but another threat is more useful. Try to find an even better way
to target a white piece.}) 9. Ne3 {Good idea! How should you expose the white
king?} Nxf3+ {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Trade knights to force open White's king protection.]} (9...
Bxf3 $2 10. gxf3 {Black is only slightly better. Try again and look for a
better capture.}) (9... Bh5 $2 10. g4 {White breaks the pin on f3 with an OK
position. Try again and look for a stronger attacking move.}) 10. gxf3 {
White's kingside is exposed. How should you take advantage?} Bh3 {[%wrong
There's a better option. Try again and look for a good threat.] [%hint Save
your bishop and make a threat.] Well played! White will have difficulty
defending the exposed king and Black will aim for a quick mate if the queen
can ever reach g2.} (10... Bh5 $2 11. c3 {Black is only slightly better. Try
again and look for a more aggressive bishop move.}) (10... Be6 $2 11. Bxe6 {
Black is only slightly better. Try again and look for a more aggressive bishop
move.}) (10... Bd7 $2 11. c3 {Black is only slightly better. Try again and
look for a more aggressive bishop move.}) (10... Bc8 $2 11. Ng2 {Black is only
slightly better. Try again and look for a more aggressive bishop move.}) *

{Black has a dangerous attack, but White's bishop blocks the g-file. What
should you do about it?} 13... h5 {[%wrong There's a better attacking move.
Try again and look for a way to take advantage of the pinned bishop on g3.] 
[%hint Prepare to threaten the g3-bishop with a pawn.]} (13... b5 $5 {This is
a useful move, but it's best to attack immediately on the kingside. How should
you do it?}) (13... Rg6 $5 {This is OK, but it's best to include a pawn in
your kingside attack. How should you do it?}) (13... Qd7 $5 {This is OK, but
it's best to include a pawn in your kingside attack. How should you do it?}) (
13... d5 $2 14. exd5 {Black has only a slight advantage. Try again and look
for a way to attack on the kingside.}) (13... f5 $2 14. exf5 {Black has only a
slight advantage. Try again and look for a stronger way to attack on the
kingside.}) 14. Kh1 {Good start! How should you continue the attack?} h4 {
[%wrong There's a stronger attacking option. Try to find a good threat.] 
[%hint Force the g3-bishop off of the open file.]} (14... Bxf2 $5 {Black is
doing well, but it's simpler to threaten the g3-bishop another way. How should
you do it?}) (14... b5 $5 {This is reasonable, but there's a stronger threat
on the kingside. Try to find it.}) 15. Bxh4 {White would have been better off
sacrificing the g3-bishop. Now Black can win White's queen. How?} Bg2+ {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good check.] [%hint
Find a winning check.]} 16. Kg1 {Nice move! How should you continue the attack?
} Bxf3+ {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for the
strongest check.] [%hint Use a discovered check to win the white queen.]} (
16... Bh3+ $2 17. Bg3 {White's bishop retreats and defends the kingside. Try
again and look for a better check.}) (16... Qd7 $5 {This is a strong option,
but there's a way to quickly win the white queen. Try to find it.}) (16... Qc8
$5 {This is a strong option, but there's a way to quickly win the white queen.
Try to find it.}) 17. Kf1 {Keep it up! How should you win material?} Bxd1 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Find a capture to win material.] Well played! This is the sort of trouble that
the pins on f3 or f6 can cause for either player.} *

{Pinning a knight on the kingside is rarely advantageous before the opponent
has castled. How can Black take advantage of the poorly placed bishop on h4?} 
7... g5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good threat.]
[%hint Attack the h4-bishop.]} (7... O-O $2 8. Na4 {White grabs the bishop
pair with a slight advantage. Try again and look for a good threat.}) (7... Be6
$2 8. Nd5 {This is reasonable, but the position is roughly even. Try again and
look for a strong threat.}) (7... Bg4 $2 8. h3 {White chases away the bishop
with an OK game. Try again and look for a good threat.}) 8. Nxg5 {White should
have retreated the bishop to g3, where it's possible, but material remains
even. White's knight sacrifice looks scary, but Black can refute it. How?} hxg5
{[%wrong White keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a way to win
material.] [%hint Find a good capture.]} 9. Bxg5 {Good choice! What should you
do about the pin on f6?} Rg8 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and
look for a strong threat.] [%hint Attack the g5-bishop.]} (9... Be6 $5 {
Black is doing well, but it's stronger to attack the g5-bishop. How should you
do it?}) (9... Qd7 $2 10. Bxf6 {White wins the knight on f6. Try again and
look for a good counter-attacking option.}) (9... Bb4 $2 10. Qf3 {Black has no
good way to defend the pinned knight on f6. Try again and look for a useful
counter-attacking move.}) (9... Bg4 $2 10. Bxf6 {White wins back the
sacrificed piece. Try again and look for a better counter-attacking move.}) 10.
h4 {Nice move! How should you prevent White from applying more pressure to the
pinned knight on f6?} Bb4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find a good
way to prevent White from playing Nd5.] [%hint Pin the c3-knight.] Good work!
White won't be able to take advantage of the pin on f6. Eventually, Black
should convert the material advantage into a win.} (10... Rxg5 $2 11. hxg5 {
The open h-file gives White a winning attack. Try again and look for a
stronger defensive move.}) (10... Rg6 $2 11. Nd5 {White will use the pin on f6
to win material. Try again and look for a way to prevent White's knight from
reaching d5.}) (10... Be6 $5 {Black is doing well, but there's a pin that's
stronger. Try to find it.}) (10... Bg4 $5 {Black is doing well, but there's a
pin that's stronger. Try to find it.}) (10... Nb4 $2 11. a3 {After the knight
retreats from b4, White will play Nd5 with a winning attack. Try again and
look for a better option.}) (10... Nd4 $2 11. Nd5 {White will use the pin on
f6 to win material. Try again and look for a better option.}) *
